analogy.rationale: CAR (NR1I3) is a xenobiotic-sensing nuclear receptor with low hepatic expression in most of these cell lines, so direct CAR agonists elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor agonists (FXR, LXR, PPAR, VDR) that share the NR superfamily mechanism and may cross-react weakly, while cytochrome P450 inhibitors reflect the shared downstream CYP induction program.
